newsitem.title: USA: Banyan sets shareholder rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Banyan sets shareholder rights offering.

text.p: Banyan Corp said Tuesday directors authorized a rights offering to shareholders of record as of December 9.

Those shareholders may purchase one right for each share held through January 10 for $0.01 each. Each right entitles its holder to purchase two common shares at a price of $0.125 a share, the company said.
It said the rights will become exercisable in a series of cumulating portions throughout 1997.

The offering is part of a recapitalization plan that includes a 1-for-20 reverse stock split for Banyan's Class A common and a private offering of shares expected to raise an aggregate of $800,000 by December 31.
After the recapitalization is completed, the company said, it will have 998,301 outstanding shares.

Chief executive Cameron Yost stated, "The restructuring of capital stock and current recapitalization efforts are in line with Banyan's goal of becoming a premier supplier of accessory products for the rapidly growing notebook computer market.

"Furthermore, with the issuance of the rights, existing shareholders will be able to share in the company's opportunities as its plans to embark on an aggressive expansion program in 1997." -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
